does: Melts the fat out of bacon or skin over gentle heat, leaving the meat crisp and the fat clear for cooking.
how: Start with a cold pan and no added fat.
Lay the pieces in a single layer and set the pan over medium-low heat.
Let the fat run slowly, stirring now and then.
Turn the heat up at the end to crisp the pieces, then lift them out and keep the fat.

cues.text: A slow sizzle that grows as the fat pools.
Clear fat in the pan, and pieces that have shrunk and turned golden at the edges.

mistakes.mistake: Starting in a hot pan, which browns the outside before the fat has melted, so that the pieces stay chewy.
mistakes.fix: Start cold and take your time.
